verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents spend caps, budget limits, billing thresholds, or usage alerts for Neon. The pages that appear (Autoscaling and Scale to Zero titles, and a free tier that needs no credit card) are adjacent cost-related features, not caps or alerts on spend.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spend caps or usage alerts so a runaway query or traffic spike cannot produce a surprise bill
